product_metadata.title: Personalized | Handcrafted Soy Candle | 4oz or 9oz Amber & Clear Jars| Many Scents to Choose From| Free Shipping
features: Butterscotch & Bourbon - Butterscotch grows up in this modern, deliciously decadent cocktail. Freshly uncasked from rich oak barrels, finely aged bourbon is merged with golden butterscotch and fragrant, sweet vanilla to unite and enhance this luscious accord
Seaside Mist - A clean, inviting fragrance with peony, water lily, and lavender softness warmed by light wood tones.
Spring Rain - You want to get caught in this downpour! A fresh and earthy rain scent with just a hinting afternote of lavender.

Warm Leather and Spice- It’s time to get out for an adventure on the open road. The bright citrus of bergamot and grapefruit, play with dark saffron and fiery red pepper, while worn leather and smoky tobacco undertone sit below.
Strawberries & Champagne - Fresh strawberries highlighted by notes of jasmine, rose, sandalwood and orange slices.
description: Personalized beautiful Soy Candles that smell AMAZING!

These candles are in beautiful 4oz or 9oz Amber Jars or 9oz Clear jars and will burn approximately 18-40 hours. •Personalize the label since each candle is custom made. •Ships quickly! •Say I Love You, Miss You, Happy Birthday, Congratulations Graduate, Happy Mother's Day or  anything that will bring a smile to you or someone else.
A great gift for Mom, Dad, Sister, Sweetheart, Brother, Aunt, Uncle, Friends, Valentine, or anyone special.
Try my Spring and Father's Day scents!
•Lavender Sage Rosemary - Definite top notes of Lavender en Provence softened by velvety sage and organic rosemary.
•Lavender Vanilla - A combination of soft lavender and creamy vanilla
•Amber Romance - Blend of exotic spices with delicate florals of Indian jasmine and orchid.
•Eucalyptus Spearmint - Eucalyptus Oil clears the mind while Spearmint Oil uplifts.
•Love Spell - Lush blend of fruits and florals with a warm & musky base
•Egyptian Amber - Fresh greens, warm spice and earthy patchouli blend with a delicate floral accord of blooming lily to create an exotic tone
•Fresh Linen - Clean ozone and cotton notes with hints of jasmine, lilac, and peony mellow into a base of white musk.
•Georgia Peach - Fresh orange sweetens this recreation of juicy, ripe peach.
•Honeysuckle Jasmine - Green foliage blends with sweet jasmine as it intertwines with blooming honeysuckle in this garden blend.
•Lemon Grass - A slightly green citrus bouquet with lemon and orange notes.
•Love Spell - Lush blend of fruits and florals with a warm & musky base
•Mountain Spruce - Fresh spruce accented by hints of raspberry, juicy Mandarin
